name: Cairo International Airport

handling.v: private jets are handled at Terminal 1, Hall 4
handling.quote: Terminal1- hall4, which is dedicated to Private Jet services

notes: Egypt's AIP (NANSC) is not published openly online; only a NOTAM summary PDF on nansceg.net was found. All AD 2 facts need the AIP from NANSC. The Cairo Airport Company general-aviation page is undated and looks old (it mentions jets 'up to the G5' and fees in USD); treat the Hall 4 fact as needing a recheck with the airport before publishing. Fees on that page were deliberately not recorded (no prices rule).
